newsitem.title: USA: Darrell Cruea named new South Dakota ag secretary.
newsitem.headline: Darrell Cruea named new South Dakota ag secretary.

text.p: South Dakota Governor Bill Janklow appointed Darrell Cruea as the state's Secretary of Agriculture, the governor's office said in a release.
Cruea will succeed Dean Anderson, who will retire September 27.

Cruea currently is an agriculture specialist in the governor's Office of Economic Development, working with communities to develop value-added agriculture in South Dakota. He is the former head of Chadron (Neb.) State University's agriculture department.
